question: Will this long ABS lid warp or lift its corners when I print it on an open printer?

plan.question: Will this long ABS lid warp or lift its corners when I print it on an open printer?

reasons.decided: lid.py is a .py file, read as a part (parametric)

steps.headline: Warps 3.81 mm off flat, over the 0.8 mm tolerance, with a corner lifting 3.81 mm when it comes off the bed.

assumptions.assumed: bed temperature not given, so Wobbl assumed 100 C, usual for ABS
no enclosure mentioned, so the part cools in open air at 25 C
print direction not given, so the part prints the way it is drawn, layers along z
infill not given, so Wobbl treated the part as solid, as the calibration plates were
